chunks: And Ḥafṣ ibn al-Bakhtarī narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
Regarding a man who marries a virgin in mutʿah, he said: "It is disliked due to the reproach against her family."
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on contracting mutʿah marriage with a virgin according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning mutʿah with a virgin woman. Imam Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام states that it is considered disliked because of the social reproach and harm it may bring upon her family.
